misuse.text: Don't say 'for sure' if you might cancel.
misuse.why: It sounds like a firm promise.

publish.title: What does "for sure" mean?
publish.value: For sure = Yes, definitely. Example: "Pizza tonight? For sure!" (casual English, US).
